first_page: Markets page /markets/ for people who check prices and want no ads. First: "aapl" or "markets" opens a quote (price, change, ranges, volume) with a 1D-5Y chart, crypto from the existing /api/markets beside stocks, a watchlist kept on the device, and a link that holds the symbol list. Will not build: portfolios, brokerage links, screeners, options, advice or anything that trades.
